"Please research the following information about the American sports event where the winners receive a handcrafted metal trophy from a renowned luxury company, named after a legendary sports figure who passed away in the early 1970s. I need annual statistics from 2001 to 2025 (including 2001 and 2025) for this event. If viewership is unavailable, use '-' instead.

Please give me the organized data in the format of one Markdown table, with the column names as: Year, Champion, Host Stadium, Host City, Nielsen HHLD Rating, Viewership (million), Half-time Show Sponsors. For host city, give the full name of the city, like Houston.

Don't ask me any questions, just output the results according to the columns without omitting cells arbitrarily. The output format is ```markdown
{data_content}
```."
